column2: Constant discouragement from his friends almost made him quit the band.
column3: 朋友不斷潑冷水，差點讓他退出樂團。
column5: dis 去掉 + courage 勇氣 → 勇氣被拿走就是氣餒

column2: The Tang dynasty is remembered for its great poets and busy trade routes.
column3: 唐朝因偉大的詩人和繁忙的貿易路線而被後人記住。
column5: 同一家族一代傳一代當皇帝，像接力賽跑

column2: She plugged the earphone into her phone and began to listen to music.
column3: 她把耳機插進手機，開始聽音樂。
column5: ear 耳朵 + phone 聽筒 → 塞進耳朵的小聽筒

column2: My sister studies economics because she wants to understand why prices rise.
column3: 我姊姊念經濟學，因為她想了解物價為何上漲。
column5: 經濟學是研究錢怎麼流動、物價為何漲跌的學問

column2: The economist predicted that the price of rice would fall next year.
column3: 那位經濟學者預測明年米價會下跌。
column4: a leading economist (頂尖經濟學者)
column5: economics 經濟學 + ist 專家 → 研究經濟的人

column2: Grandma practices strict economy and never wastes a single grain of rice.
column3: 奶奶厲行節約，連一粒米都不浪費。
column5: 把錢包捏緊、一分一分花，就是 economy 的節約意思

column2: The new machine works with great efficiency and saves us hours every day.
column3: 這台新機器效率很高，每天替我們省下好幾個小時。
column5: efficient 是勤快的人，名詞 efficiency 就是做事又快又省

column2: He wants to study electronics so he can build his own robot.
column3: 他想學電子學，這樣就能自己做機器人。
column5: electron 電子 + ics 學問 → 電子學，手機電路板就是它

column2: Her face turned red with embarrassment when she forgot her lines on stage.
column3: 她在台上忘詞時，臉因難堪而漲紅。
column5: em 讓人 + bar 欄杆 + ass：想像被欄杆卡住的窘樣

column2: The teacher put special emphasis on spelling before the big test.
column3: 大考前老師特別強調拼字。
column5: em 在裡面 + phasis 顯示：把重點亮出來給大家看

column2: My uncle works in civil engineering and helps design bridges.
column3: 我叔叔從事土木工程，協助設計橋梁。
column5: engine 引擎 + er：會讓機器和橋樑動起來的學問

column2: The enlargement of the photo let us see every small detail on the wall.
column3: 照片放大後，我們看得見牆上每個小細節。
column5: en 使成為 + large 大 + ment → 把它變大

column2: Movies, concerts, and games are popular forms of entertainment among teenagers.
column3: 電影、演唱會和遊戲是青少年之間受歡迎的娛樂形式。
column4: a form of entertainment (一種娛樂)
column5: enter 進場 + tain 拿著 + ment：進場拿著爆米花享受

column2: The gym bought new equipment, including bikes and heavy weights.
column3: 健身房買了新設備，包括腳踏車和重量器材。
column5: equip 配備好 + ment：整套配好的家當

column2: People lived without phones in the era before the internet.
column3: 在網路出現之前的年代，人們沒有手機也能生活。
column5: era 像「一啦」：一個長長的時代，一啦就過了好多年

column2: Mom sent me on an errand to buy eggs and milk.
column3: 媽媽派我出去跑腿買蛋和牛奶。
column5: 「兒爛」：小孩被叫去跑腿跑到腿爛

column2: Hold the handrail when you ride the escalator at the mall.
column3: 在購物中心搭電扶梯時要扶好扶手。
column5: 想像電扶梯一階一階往上爬，像爬樓梯的機器

column2: Our teacher asked us to write an essay about our favorite season.
column3: 老師要我們寫一篇關於最喜歡季節的短文。
column5: 「ㄟ誰」：誰寫的這篇文章？想像老師在問

column2: The establishment of the school in 1890 gave local children a place to learn.
column3: 1890 年學校的創立，讓當地孩子有了讀書的地方。
column5: establish 建立 + ment → 把學校穩穩立起來

column2: We cooked a big dinner on the eve of the Lunar New Year.
column3: 農曆新年前夕，我們煮了一頓豐盛的晚餐。
column5: eve 和 evening 長得像：節日前一晚就是 eve

column2: Each examinee must show an ID card before entering the test room.
column3: 每位應試者進入考場前都必須出示身分證。
column4: a nervous examinee (緊張的應試者)
column5: examine 考 + ee 被…的人 → 被考的人

column2: The examiner listened carefully to each student's English speech.
column3: 主考官仔細聆聽每位學生的英語演說。
column4: a strict examiner (嚴格的主考官)
column5: examine 考 + er 做事的人 → 出題打分的人

column2: The rapid expansion of the city created many new jobs.
column3: 這座城市快速擴張，創造了許多新工作。
column5: ex 向外 + pand 展開 → 像氣球向外撐開

column2: Too much exposure to the sun can burn your skin.
column3: 過度曝曬在陽光下會曬傷皮膚。
column4: exposure to sunlight (暴露在陽光下)
column5: ex 出來 + pose 擺姿勢：站到外面讓人看見

column2: The young singer won fame after her first song became a hit.
column3: 這位年輕歌手的第一首歌爆紅後，她就成名了。
column5: fame 像「廢姆」：名氣大到人人都喊你的名字

column2: As a child, he lived in a fantasy of flying dragons and magic castles.
column3: 小時候他活在飛龍與魔法城堡的幻想中。
column4: a world of fantasy (幻想世界)
column5: 「翻他三」：翻開故事書，幻想一個又一個

column2: The class sang a song to say farewell to their teacher.
column3: 全班唱了一首歌向老師道別。
column5: fare 旅程 + well 好 → 祝你一路順風

column2: Children in the village set off a firecracker to welcome the new year.
column3: 村裡的孩子燃放一枚鞭炮來迎接新年。
column5: fire 火 + cracker 爆裂物 → 點火就啪啪響

column2: The formation of ice on the lake took only one cold night.
column3: 湖面結冰只花了一個寒冷的夜晚。
column5: form 形成 + ation → 一步步成形的過程

column2: Scientists use a simple formula to find the area of a circle.
column3: 科學家用一條簡單的公式來求圓的面積。
column5: 「佛謬啦」：佛說謬誤啦，要用對公式才不會算錯

column2: Soldiers once guarded the old fort at the edge of the sea.
column3: 士兵們曾經守衛海邊那座古老的堡壘。
column5: fort 像 forth：堡壘站在最前面守住

column2: The foundation of the house must be strong enough to hold the walls.
column3: 房子的地基必須夠堅固，才撐得住牆壁。
column5: found 建立 + ation：蓋房子先打的那層底

column2: The founder of the company started it in a small garage.
column3: 這家公司的創辦人是在一間小車庫裡起步的。
column5: found 創立 + er 人 → 創立的那個人

column2: Every freshman at our school joins a club in the first month.
column3: 我們學校每位新生都在第一個月加入一個社團。
column5: fresh 新鮮 + man 人 → 剛來的新鮮人

column2: He kicked the wall in frustration after losing the game for the third time.
column3: 他第三次輸掉比賽後，沮喪地踢了牆壁一下。
column5: frustrate 讓人洩氣 + ion：事情不順的悶悶心情

column2: Finishing the marathon gave her a deep sense of fulfillment.
column3: 跑完馬拉松讓她有深深的成就感。
column5: full 滿 + fill 填 + ment → 心裡被填得滿滿的

column2: Many relatives dressed in black and came to the funeral to say goodbye.
column3: 許多親戚穿著黑衣來參加葬禮道別。
column5: 想像親友穿黑衣、獻白花，安靜向故人道別

column2: The art gallery displays paintings by students from nearby schools.
column3: 這間美術館展出附近學校學生的畫作。
column5: 走進長長的展廳，牆上掛滿畫，就是 gallery

column2: The movie is about a gangster who tries to leave his old crew.
column3: 這部電影講述一個想脫離舊幫派的歹徒。
column4: a notorious gangster (惡名昭彰的歹徒)
column5: gang 一夥人 + ster 人 → 屬於壞幫派的人

column2: Each generation of farmers has found new ways to grow food.
column3: 每一世代的農夫都找到了新的種植方法。
column5: gener 生出 + ation：爺爺、爸爸、你，一代生一代
